This entry is NOT validated against current published research — treat every mechanism and claimed efficacy [ESTIMATE] claim as unverified legacy material until full v2 enhancement lands. \n\nModern LLM systems frequently operate within agentic frameworks where a planner model decomposes tasks and assigns subtasks to specialized agents or external tools. The attacker embeds adversarial intent inside seemingly benign subtask specifications. Instead of directly requesting restricted actions, the prompt encourages the orchestrating model to generate intermediate objectives that appear harmless individually but collectively achieve the adversarial goal.\\n\\nBecause each agent or tool processes only its assigned subtask context, global safety intent may not be recognized.
